Requires Attunement by a character with renown in the Ashen Verdict.

This metal band is set with five gleaming crystals shaped like a beast's claw. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent, a stylized O, is stamped inside it.

While wearing this ring, you gain the following benefits (Ashen Verdict renown required in parentheses).

Courage (Uncommon, Renown 3+). You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

Greater Courage (Rare, Renown 10+). You also gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

Unmatched Courage (Very Rare, Renown 25+). You also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

Endless Courage (Legendary, Renown 50+). You also have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

Foundry Note

Roll your saves against Charmed and Frightened with Advantage yourself.
